question_en: Which statements are true? 1) Pressure is produced by the component of force perpendicular to the surface. 2) Hydrostatic pressure depends on the shape of the vessel. 3) Pascal's law holds in liquids and gases. 4) Atmospheric pressure increases as one climbs a mountain.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Bosimni kuchning sirtga tik tashkil etuvchisi hosil qiladi. 2) Gidrostatik bosim idish shakliga bog'liq. 3) Paskal qonuni suyuqlik va gazlarda bajariladi. 4) Tog'ga ko'tarilganda atmosfera bosimi ortadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Давление создаёт составляющая силы, перпендикулярная поверхности. 2) Гидростатическое давление зависит от формы сосуда. 3) Закон Паскаля выполняется в жидкостях и газах. 4) При подъёме в горы атмосферное давление растёт.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Gidrostatik bosim faqat ρ va h ga bog'liq (2 — noto'g'ri); balandlikda bosim kamayadi (4 — noto'g'ri).
Asos: p = ρgh.

en: 4 — false: the pressure is lower higher up.

distractors.A: 2-fikr noto'g'ri: bosim idish shakliga bog'liq emas

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 неверно: давление не зависит от формы

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: pressure does not depend on shape
distractors_en.E: statement 1 is also true and 4 is false

explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m², demak 1 N/cm² = 10⁴ Pa; 30 · 10⁴ = 3·10⁵ Pa.
Asos: 1 Pa = 1 N/m².

distractors_en.C: error in the power of ten

question_en: What pressure does a carpet of mass $6\ \mathrm{kg}$ and area $4\ \mathrm{m^2}$ exert on the floor ($\mathrm{Pa}$)?
question_uz: Massasi $6\ \mathrm{kg}$, yuzi $4\ \mathrm{m^2}$ bo'lgan gilam polga qanday bosim beradi ($\mathrm{Pa}$)?
question_ru: Какое давление на пол оказывает ковёр массой $6\ \mathrm{kg}$ и площадью $4\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ($\mathrm{Pa}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. F = mg = 60 N; p = F/S = 60/4 = 15 Pa.
Asos: p = mg/S.

distractors_en.A: mass was used instead of weight
distractors_en.B: the mass was multiplied by the area
distractors_en.C: the area was divided by the mass

question_en: The diameter of a circular surface is increased $3$ times while the force stays the same. Find the pressure ratio $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$.
question_uz: Doira shaklidagi sirtning diametri $3$ marta oshirildi, kuch o'zgarmadi. Bosimlar nisbati $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Диаметр круглой поверхности увеличили в $3$ раза, сила не изменилась. Найдите отношение давлений $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. S = πd²/4: diametr 3 marta oshsa, yuza 9 marta oshadi, bosim 9 marta kamayadi.
Asos: p = F/S.

en: Area of a circle: $$S=\frac{\pi d^2}{4},\qquad S_2=9S_1$$

distractors.E: kuch o'zgarmagani uchun bosim ham o'zgarmaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: раз сила не изменилась, сочли, что и давление не меняется

distractors_en.A: pressure was taken proportional to the diameter
distractors_en.C: area was taken proportional to the diameter
distractors_en.D: pressure was taken proportional to the area
distractors_en.E: assumed that the pressure stays the same because the force does

question_en: Three bodies made of materials with densities $\rho_1>\rho_2>\rho_3$ have equal masses and equal base areas. How are their pressures $p_1$, $p_2$, $p_3$ on a horizontal plane related?
question_uz: Zichliklari $\rho_1>\rho_2>\rho_3$ bo'lgan uch xil moddadan yasalgan uch jismning massalari va asoslarining yuzlari teng. Ularning gorizontal tekislikka bosimlari $p_1$, $p_2$, $p_3$ qanday munosabatda?
question_ru: Три тела из веществ с плотностями $\rho_1>\rho_2>\rho_3$ имеют равные массы и равные площади оснований. Как соотносятся их давления $p_1$, $p_2$, $p_3$ на горизонтальную плоскость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. p = mg/S, massalar va yuzalar teng — bosimlar teng; zichlik faqat balandlikni o'zgartiradi.
Asos: p = mg/S.

distractors.A: p = ρgh qo'llanib, balandliklar teng deb olingan
distractors.B: zichlik katta bo'lsa bosim kichik deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: применили p = ρgh, считая высоты равными
distractors_ru.B: сочли, что при большей плотности давление меньше

distractors_en.A: used p = ρgh assuming equal heights
distractors_en.B: assumed a denser body gives less pressure
distractors_en.C: only the first body was singled out
distractors_en.D: only the third body was singled out

question_en: At a depth $h$ in a lake the hydrostatic pressure is $1.5\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Find the hydrostatic pressure at a point $20\ \mathrm{m}$ deeper ($\mathrm{MPa}$).
question_uz: Ko'lning $h$ chuqurligida gidrostatik bosim $1.5\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Undan $20\ \mathrm{m}$ chuqurroq nuqtadagi gidrostatik bosimni toping ($\mathrm{MPa}$).
question_ru: На глубине $h$ в озере гидростатическое давление $1.5\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Найдите гидростатическое давление в точке на $20\ \mathrm{m}$ глубже ($\mathrm{MPa}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Δp = ρgΔh = 1000 · 10 · 20 = 0,2 MPa; p = 1,5 + 0,2 = 1,7 MPa.
Asos: p = ρgh.

uz: Qo'shimcha suv ustuni bosimi: $$\Delta p=\rho g\Delta h=1000\cdot10\cdot20=0.2\ \mathrm{MPa}$$
ru: Давление дополнительного столба: $$\Delta p=\rho g\Delta h=1000\cdot10\cdot20=0.2\ \mathrm{MPa}$$
en: Pressure of the extra column: $$\Delta p=\rho g\Delta h=1000\cdot10\cdot20=0.2\ \mathrm{MPa}$$

distractors.C: 20 m suv ustuni 2 MPa deb olingan
distractors.D: 20 m suv ustuni 20 kPa deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: столб воды 20 м принят за 2 МПа
distractors_ru.D: столб воды 20 м принят за 20 кПа

distractors_en.C: a 20 m water column was taken as 2 MPa
distractors_en.D: a 20 m water column was taken as 20 kPa
distractors_en.E: the extra pressure was taken as 0.5 MPa

question_en: The pressure of water on the bottom of a vessel is $3$ times that of kerosene. Find the ratio of the heights of the water and kerosene columns $\frac{h_1}{h_2}$. $\rho_1=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho_2=800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_uz: Suvning idish tubiga bosimi kerosin beradigan bosimdan $3$ marta katta. Suv va kerosin ustunlari balandliklarining nisbati $\frac{h_1}{h_2}$ ni toping. $\rho_1=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho_2=800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_ru: Давление воды на дно сосуда в $3$ раза больше давления керосина. Найдите отношение высот столбов воды и керосина $\frac{h_1}{h_2}$. $\rho_1=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho_2=800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. ρ₁gh₁ = 3ρ₂gh₂, h₁/h₂ = 3 · 800/1000 = 2,4.
Asos: p = ρgh.

distractors_en.A: the difference in densities was ignored
distractors_en.D: the ratio was inverted and densities ignored
distractors_en.E: only the density ratio was used

question_en: A vessel of water stands in an elevator car. The elevator moves downward with acceleration $a<g$. Which formula gives the water pressure on the bottom of the vessel?
question_uz: Suv quyilgan idish lift kabinasida turibdi. Lift pastga $a<g$ tezlanish bilan harakatlanmoqda. Suvning idish tubiga bosimi qaysi formula bilan ifodalanadi?
question_ru: Сосуд с водой стоит в кабине лифта. Лифт движется вниз с ускорением $a<g$. По какой формуле выражается давление воды на дно сосуда?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Pastga tezlanishda suv «yengillashadi»: p = ρ(g − a)h; a = 0 da ρgh, a = g da 0.
Asos: p = ρ(g − a)h.

uz: Idish bilan bog'liq sanoq sistemasida: $$g\to g-a$$
en: In the frame of the vessel: $$g\to g-a$$

distractors_en.C: the direction of the acceleration was reversed
distractors_en.E: sign error: the pressure comes out negative

question_en: A cube-shaped aquarium is full of water. The water pressure on the bottom of the aquarium is $5\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Find the mass of the water ($\mathrm{kg}$).
question_uz: Kub shaklidagi akvarium suv bilan to'la. Suvning akvarium tubiga bosimi $5\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Suvning massasini toping ($\mathrm{kg}$).
question_ru: Аквариум в форме куба заполнен водой. Давление воды на дно аквариума $5\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Найдите массу воды ($\mathrm{kg}$).

uz: Kub qirrasi suv chuqurligiga teng: $$a=\frac{p}{\rho g}=\frac{5000}{1000\cdot10}=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$$
ru: Ребро куба равно глубине воды: $$a=\frac{p}{\rho g}=\frac{5000}{1000\cdot10}=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$$
en: The cube edge equals the water depth: $$a=\frac{p}{\rho g}=\frac{5000}{1000\cdot10}=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$$

distractors_en.A: the decimal point was shifted by one place
distractors_en.B: the area (a²) was used instead of the volume
distractors_en.C: the volume was taken as 0.5 m³

question_en: Two immiscible liquids are poured into a U-shaped vessel. The ratio of the column heights measured from the interface is $\frac{h_1}{h_2}=\frac{4}{3}$. Find the density ratio $\frac{\rho_1}{\rho_2}$.
question_uz: U-simon idishga aralashmaydigan ikki suyuqlik quyilgan. Ajralish sathidan hisoblangan ustunlar balandliklarining nisbati $\frac{h_1}{h_2}=\frac{4}{3}$. Zichliklar nisbati $\frac{\rho_1}{\rho_2}$ ni toping.
question_ru: В U-образный сосуд налиты две несмешивающиеся жидкости. Отношение высот столбов, отсчитанных от уровня раздела, $\frac{h_1}{h_2}=\frac{4}{3}$. Найдите отношение плотностей $\frac{\rho_1}{\rho_2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. ρ₁h₁ = ρ₂h₂ ⇒ ρ₁/ρ₂ = h₂/h₁ = 3/4.
Asos: tutash idishlar — ρ₁h₁ = ρ₂h₂.

en: At the interface the pressures are equal: $$\rho_1h_1=\rho_2h_2$$

distractors.A: zichlik balandlikka to'g'ri proporsional deb olingan
distractors.C: tutash idishda sathlar doim teng deb olingan

distractors_en.A: density was taken as directly proportional to height
distractors_en.C: assumed the levels are always equal

question_en: In Torricelli's experiment the mercury column is $750\ \mathrm{mm}$. How tall would the water column in the tube be if the experiment were done with water ($\mathrm{m}$)? $\rho_{Hg}=13600\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_uz: Torrichelli tajribasida simob ustuni $750\ \mathrm{mm}$. Tajriba suv bilan o'tkazilsa, naydagi suv ustuni qanday balandlikda bo'lar edi ($\mathrm{m}$)? $\rho_{Hg}=13600\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_ru: В опыте Торричелли столб ртути $750\ \mathrm{mm}$. Какой высоты был бы столб воды в трубке, если бы опыт проводили с водой ($\mathrm{m}$)? $\rho_{Hg}=13600\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ikkala ustun bir xil p₀ ni muvozanatlaydi: h = 0,75 · 13600/1000 = 10,2 m.
Asos: p₀ = ρgh.

uz: Ikkala ustun bir xil $p_0$ ni beradi: $$\rho_{Hg}gh_{Hg}=\rho gh$$
en: Both columns give the same $p_0$: $$\rho_{Hg}gh_{Hg}=\rho gh$$

distractors.B: suv ustuni simobniki bilan bir xil deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the water column was taken equal to the mercury one
distractors_en.D: only the density ratio was used

question_en: At sea level the atmospheric pressure is $760\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$. Find the pressure at an altitude of $540\ \mathrm{m}$ above sea level ($\mathrm{mm\,Hg}$). The pressure drops by $1\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$ for every $12\ \mathrm{m}$.
question_uz: Dengiz sathida atmosfera bosimi $760\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$. Dengiz sathidan $540\ \mathrm{m}$ balandlikdagi bosimni toping ($\mathrm{mm\,Hg}$). Har $12\ \mathrm{m}$ da bosim $1\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$ ga kamayadi.
question_ru: На уровне моря атмосферное давление $760\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$. Найдите давление на высоте $540\ \mathrm{m}$ над уровнем моря ($\mathrm{mm\,Hg}$). На каждые $12\ \mathrm{m}$ давление уменьшается на $1\ \mathrm{mm\,Hg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Δp = 540/12 = 45 mm Hg; p = 760 − 45 = 715 mm Hg.
Asos: har 12 m da ≈ 1 mm Hg.

distractors.A: bosim balandlikka bog'liq emas deb olingan
distractors.D: har 10 m da 1 mm Hg deb olingan
distractors.E: har 9 m da 1 mm Hg deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: давление сочли не зависящим от высоты
distractors_ru.D: принято 1 мм рт. ст. на каждые 10 м
distractors_ru.E: принято 1 мм рт. ст. на каждые 9 м

distractors_en.A: pressure was assumed independent of altitude
distractors_en.D: 1 mm Hg per 10 m was used
distractors_en.E: 1 mm Hg per 9 m was used

question_en: At what depth in the ocean is the total pressure $6$ times the atmospheric pressure ($p_0=10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$) ($\mathrm{m}$)? Take the density of water as $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_uz: Okeanning qanday chuqurligida to'liq bosim atmosfera bosimidan ($p_0=10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$) $6$ marta katta bo'ladi ($\mathrm{m}$)? Suv zichligini $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ deb oling.
question_ru: На какой глубине океана полное давление в $6$ раз больше атмосферного ($p_0=10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$) ($\mathrm{m}$)? Плотность воды примите $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. p₀ + ρgh = 6p₀ ⇒ ρgh = 5p₀ = 5·10⁵ Pa, h = 50 m.
Asos: p = p₀ + ρgh.

distractors_en.D: the result is 10 times too large

question_en: The small piston of a hydraulic press has an area of $5\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ and the large one $750\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. If the small piston is pushed down at $45\ \mathrm{cm/s}$, at what speed does the large piston rise ($\mathrm{cm/s}$)?
question_uz: Gidravlik press kichik porshenining yuzi $5\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, kattasiniki $750\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Kichik porshen $45\ \mathrm{cm/s}$ tezlik bilan tushirilsa, katta porshen qanday tezlik bilan ko'tariladi ($\mathrm{cm/s}$)?
question_ru: Площадь малого поршня гидравлического пресса $5\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, большого — $750\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Если малый поршень опускать со скоростью $45\ \mathrm{cm/s}$, с какой скоростью поднимается большой поршень ($\mathrm{cm/s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Har sekundda ko'chgan hajmlar teng: S₁v₁ = S₂v₂, v₂ = 45 · 5/750 = 0,3 cm/s.
Asos: S₁h₁ = S₂h₂.

distractors_en.B: the speeds were taken as equal
distractors_en.C: the decimal point was shifted by one place
distractors_en.E: only the area ratio was used

question_en: Water is poured into a cylindrical vessel with base radius $R$ up to a height $h$. For what $h$ does the pressure force of the water on the side wall equal the force on the bottom?
question_uz: Asosining radiusi $R$ bo'lgan silindrik idishga $h$ balandlikkacha suv quyildi. $h$ qanday bo'lganda suvning idish yon devoriga bosim kuchi tubiga bosim kuchiga teng bo'ladi?
question_ru: В цилиндрический сосуд с радиусом основания $R$ налили воду до высоты $h$. При каком $h$ сила давления воды на боковую стенку равна силе давления на дно?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Tubiga ρghπR², devorga (ρgh/2) · 2πRh = πρgRh²; tenglasak h = R.
Asos: devorga o'rtacha bosim ρgh/2.

uz: Yon devorga ($S'=2\pi Rh$): $$F_2=\frac{\rho gh}{2}\cdot2\pi Rh=\pi\rho gRh^2$$
ru: Сила давления на дно: $$F_1=\rho gh\cdot\pi R^2$$
На боковую стенку ($S'=2\pi Rh$): $$F_2=\frac{\rho gh}{2}\cdot2\pi Rh=\pi\rho gRh^2$$
en: Force on the bottom: $$F_1=\rho gh\cdot\pi R^2$$
On the side wall ($S'=2\pi Rh$): $$F_2=\frac{\rho gh}{2}\cdot2\pi Rh=\pi\rho gRh^2$$
Set them equal: $$\pi\rho ghR^2=\pi\rho gRh^2\ \Rightarrow\ h=R$$

distractors_ru.A: давление на стенку принято равным ρgh

distractors_en.A: the wall pressure was taken as ρgh
distractors_en.B: the wall area was taken as πRh
distractors_en.C: a square root was taken wrongly
